mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_session (session_id, user_id, state, turn_count) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, CAST(#{stateJson} AS jsonb), 0) ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id = COALESCE(flow_session.user_id, EXCLUDED.user_id)
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, user_id, turn_count, created_at, updated_at FROM flow_session ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_message (session_id, turn_id, role, content, node_id) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{nodeId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, turn_id, role, content, node_id, created_at FROM flow_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id
